description: Interactive public display policy. Allowed sources retain their conditions and attribution; configured sources require deployer configuration; absence is denial. See docs/DATA_POLICY.md.

conditions: Preserve terrain credits
Water mask adds Protomaps and OpenStreetMap ODbL credit
ECMWF prescribed attribution and disclaimer
Identify resampling/modifications
Level-5 density only; no raw Vaisala detections
Bounded normalized metadata for visualization and general information only
Preserve EONET and referenced-source attribution and original date meanings
No inferred countries, coordinates, descriptions or linked publisher content
Approximate extents and selective curation are not authoritative incidents or independent confirmation
Bundled NOAA-20 sample only: 45 detections acquired 2026-07-16
Show acquisition date and archived/stale status
Original capture time unavailable
Do not claim current or comprehensive global coverage
Ordinary GP datasets only
Shared per-query cache at least 7200 seconds
Stop repeated queries on non-200 responses
Add value; no unchanged forwarding
Anonymous requests at most 15/hour shared across deployment

radio-audio.reason: Individual broadcaster terms are separate and unreviewed.

google-maps.reason: Integration removed from this baseline; any reintroduction needs a new review and eligible deployer agreement.

cesium-ion.reason: Ion asset integration removed; the globe uses keyless NASA/Natural Earth imagery.

tomtom.reason: Traffic integration removed; any reintroduction needs a new review and suitable deployer contract.

mapillary.reason: Street imagery integration removed; any reintroduction needs a new imagery/API terms review.

open-meteo.reason: Integration removed; its free endpoint is not cleared for commercial/promotional deployment.

esri.reason: Imagery integration removed; the keyless World Imagery endpoint is not cleared under this policy.

osrm-self-hosted.reason: Routing integration removed from this baseline.

opensky.reason: Live operational API integration needs a written licence even for nonprofits.

adsbdb.reason: No general data/service licence; route source forbids republication without permission.

aisstream.reason: Specific data redistribution/commercial rights not published in reviewed official documentation.

google-cctv-heights.reason: Bundled extracted Google 3D tile heights lack approved reuse permission.

fossgis-routing.reason: Commercial and heavy-use restrictions; configure an independently permitted routing service instead.

local-receiver.reason: Local/private decoder and SDR plumbing is outside the hosted public product.

drivebc: Review ministry ownership and licence per camera ID

ovapi-nl: Conditional requests for polling faster than once/minute

conditions: Integrated station-availability display only
No standalone dataset hosting/resale
No customer correlation
No claimed affiliation or unauthorized operator logos/trade names
